hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/toki/notas"; [ -d "$d" ] || exit 0; i=$(cat); case "$i" in *'"agent_id"'*) exit 0;; esac; s=$(printf '%s' "$i" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([A-Za-z0-9_-]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$d/$s.txt" ] && cat "$d/$s.txt"; date +%s 2>/dev/null > "$d/$s.compactada"; find "$d" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null; exit 0
